title: windows11-context-rs menu config
description: Config file for one windows11-context-rs context-menu entry. Numeric flag values and the deprecated acceptDirectory/acceptFile booleans are also accepted.

$schema.description: Optional: URL or path to this JSON schema, for editor autocomplete/validation.

title.description: Label shown in the context menu.

titlePlural.description: Label used when 2+ items are selected. Falls back to "title" if empty.

titleRules.description: Selection-dependent labels. The first rule whose acceptExts contains every selected file's extension replaces title/titlePlural; folders and mixed selections fall back to them. In the classic menu each listed extension gets its own verb with the rule's (singular) title.

acceptExts.description: '|'-separated exact extension list with leading dots (e.g. ".png|.jpg").

title.description: Label used when this rule matches.

titlePlural.description: Label used when this rule matches 2+ items. Falls back to the rule's title if empty.

classicMenu.description: Also add this entry to the classic ("Show more options") menu. Set false when another program provides its own classic-menu verbs.

exe.description: Executable to launch. Environment variables like %LocalAppData% are expanded.

param.description: Command-line arguments. Supports {path}, {parent}, {name}, {nameNoExt}, {extension} (and the *0 variants for the first selected item in join mode).

icon.description: Icon spec as "path,index" (e.g. "%LocalAppData%\\Programs\\App\\App.exe,0"), or "exe" to reuse the entry's own exe as the icon source. Environment variables are expanded.

iconDark.description: Icon spec used when Explorer is in dark mode. Falls back to "icon" if empty. Also accepts "exe". Environment variables are expanded.

acceptDirectory.description: Deprecated: use acceptDirectoryFlag instead. true = all directory types (15), false = none.

acceptDirectoryFlag.description: Which directory-like targets this entry matches. A numeric bitmask (directory=1, background=2, desktop=4, drive=8), a single name, or an array of names. Names are case/separator-insensitive ("top-left" == "TOP_LEFT").

acceptFile.description: Deprecated shorthand: false disables file matching entirely (equivalent to acceptFileFlag: "none").

acceptFileFlag.description: How this entry matches files. Numeric (0=none, 1=extension, 2=regex, 3=extensionList, 4=all) or a name.

acceptExts.description: Extensions to match. Space/fuzzy list for acceptFileFlag "extension" (e.g. ".apkx .mapk"), or a '|'-separated exact list for "extensionList" (e.g. ".apk|.apkx").

acceptFileRegex.description: Regex (Rust regex syntax) matched against the file name when acceptFileFlag is "regex".

acceptMultipleFilesFlag.description: Behavior when multiple items are selected. Numeric (0=none, 1=each, 2=join) or a name.

pathDelimiter.description: Delimiter joining quoted paths in "join" mode. Defaults to a space.

paramForMultipleFiles.description: Alternate "param" template used in "join" mode when multiple items are selected. Falls back to "param" if empty.

index.description: Sort order among entries loaded from the same directory (ties break by file name).

showWindowFlag.description: Initial window state for the launched process. Numeric (per Win32 ShowWindow) or a name.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the launched process.

copyIcon.description: Snapshot the icon into a local .ico at sync time, so the entry survives the source path changing or the app being removed (e.g. Store apps on update). If the source is unavailable on a later sync, the existing snapshot is kept.

smallIcon.description: Corner badge composited onto the entry's icon.

icon.description: Icon spec ("path,index"), "uac" for the system UAC shield, or "exe" for the entry's own exe.

location.description: Corner to place the badge in. Case/separator-insensitive.
